candidates.name: Serializer
candidates.description: A class that converts complex data types, such as querysets and model instances, into native Python data types that can then be easily rendered into JSON, XML or other content types.

candidates.name: ModelSerializer
candidates.description: A serializer that automatically creates a serializer class based on a Django model, simplifying the process of creating serializers for model instances.

candidates.name: Field
candidates.description: A class representing a single field in a serializer, defining how data should be validated and serialized.

candidates.name: Validation
candidates.description: The process of ensuring that the data provided to the serializer meets certain criteria before it is saved or processed.

candidates.name: Create Method
candidates.description: A method that defines how to create a new instance of a model from validated data in the serializer.

candidates.name: Update Method
candidates.description: A method that defines how to update an existing model instance with validated data from the serializer.

candidates.name: To_representation
candidates.description: A method that customizes how the data is converted to a representation format (like JSON) when serializing.

candidates.name: Nested Serializers
candidates.description: A feature that allows for the serialization of related models, enabling complex data structures to be represented in a single API response.

candidates.name: HyperlinkedSerializer
candidates.description: A serializer that uses hyperlinks to represent relationships instead of primary keys, providing a more RESTful API experience.

candidates.name: ViewSet

candidates.description: A specialized ViewSet that provides default implementations for CRUD operations based on a Django model, streamlining the development of RESTful APIs.

candidates.description: A ViewSet that provides read-only operations for a model, ideal for APIs that only require GET requests.

candidates.name: Custom ViewSets
candidates.description: User-defined ViewSets that extend or modify the behavior of existing ViewSets to meet specific application needs.

candidates.name: Nested ViewSets
candidates.description: ViewSets that handle nested resources, allowing for more complex data relationships in APIs.
